operations: Native realtime transcription TCP connection lifetime
Model policy checks at native JSON, SSE and realtime entry points

acceptance.realtime: Real TCP connection, same-model update, model switch, failed connection, manager shutdown, session close and pending unload. Transient workers are rejected without restoration waits under Router lock. Native disabled-model policy is checked for JSON, SSE and direct streaming. Policy callbacks execute outside the lifecycle lock.
acceptance.regressions: 10 local native contracts, 40 isolated API cases and the real CPU authenticated cache admission fixture pass

state.native_service_policy_owner: Existing Juiced policy via a Router callback; no second policy registry

qualification: This is scoped residency ownership, not resource admission or proof of accelerator termination. The P1 milestone remains unfinished.
